subject: general
question: The Ayurveda dataset on The Clinical Trials Registry-India (CTRI) Portal was launched by the ________ in July 2021.

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of AYUSH.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **ICMR and CCRAS,** Ministry of Ayush collaborated to create CTRI's Ayurveda Dataset.
 
• The WHO **International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP)** uses CTRI as its principal register of clinical trials (WHO).
 
• The ability to choose an Ayurveda health condition from a** list of 3866 Ayurveda morbidity codes **is a vital function of this digital platform.
 
• The **NAMASTE portal's codes** have been included (developed by AYUSH Ministry).
 
• The **Indian registry for clinical trials of Ayurveda** will make the information and outcomes of these studies available in Ayurvedic language.
